_about: What the family tests against, per upstream. Floors and tested latest come from the repos' locks and CI pins (see sources). The weekly job (tools/upstream_watch.py) reads PyPI and reports differences; it never changes this file.

numpy.sources: floor: eagle docs/_tools/hosted_env/floor-cpu.txt (numpy==1.26.4); latest: colab-cpu.txt and colab-gpu.txt (numpy==2.1.3)

cupy.sources: floor: eagle python/pyproject.toml (cupy-cuda1Nx>=13.6,<14 below Python 3.10; >=14 from 3.10); latest: eagle colab-gpu.txt (cupy-cuda12x==14.0.1); gaps: the pyproject comment (no cp313t) and the 3.15 ruling

unverified_gaps.cp315: from the USER 10-19 note that cupy and torch have no 3.15 wheels yet; not checked against PyPI
unverified_gaps.cp315t: from the USER 10-19 note that cupy and torch have no 3.15 wheels yet; not checked against PyPI

torch.sources: floor: eagle floor-cpu.txt (torch==2.2.2+cpu; extra torch>=2.2); latest: eagle .github/workflows/ci.yml (torch==2.14.1, free-threaded stress leg); gaps: that step's comment (torch publishes cp314t only) and the 3.15 ruling

unverified_gaps.cp315: from the USER 10-19 note that cupy and torch have no 3.15 wheels yet; not checked against PyPI
unverified_gaps.cp315t: from the USER 10-19 note that cupy and torch have no 3.15 wheels yet; not checked against PyPI

jax.sources: floor and latest: eagle python/pyproject.toml (jax>=0.11.2) and ci.yml / release.yml (jax[cpu]==0.11.2); tags: pyproject comment (Python 3.12 and newer) and ci.yml (jaxlib cp314t only); PyPI name is jaxlib, the package that carries the wheels

unverified_gaps.cp315: no repo records whether jaxlib ships cp315; assumed absent

warp.sources: floor: eagle colab-gpu.txt (warp-lang==1.16.0, the CUDA 12 build); latest: eagle ci.yml (warp-lang==1.18.0); no declared bound exists, so the floor is the oldest tested

cuda-bindings.sources: floor and ceiling: hawk pyproject.toml extras cuda12 (>=12.6,<13) and cuda13 (>=13,<14); no exact version is pinned anywhere, so the weekly run reports the newest only against the ceiling

nanobind.sources: eagle python/pyproject.toml and hawk pyproject.toml build requires (>=3.1,<4 from Python 3.10; >=2.2,<3 on 3.9); no exact version is pinned

cibuildwheel.sources: eagle and hawk .github/workflows/release.yml (pypa/cibuildwheel@v3.4.1); 4.x dropped the free-threaded 3.13 build, so it stays outside the range until that is decided

cpython.sources: eagle .github/workflows/release.yml and ci.yml matrices (3.9 to 3.14 plus 3.13t/3.14t); 3.15 is the ruling's addition. The weekly run takes the newest cpXY that numpy ships
